answer: Each node must post a bond before it can attest, and the protocol correlates registrations that share a funding trail. When several nodes echo the same deposit path, the bond is merged and slashed as one, so every extra fake identity costs the attacker the full forfeit while returning almost nothing. A single honest pearl of real work then outweighs a crowd of subsidized seats, because the attacker keeps paying rent on capital that cannot be withdrawn. Cipher-free identity claims do not exist here: a claim is worth only what its owner will lose, making mass registration a guaranteed loss.
